## Purpose

Identify the discovery ID and the exact claim, evidence, or presentation change.

## Standing effect

- [ ] No claim-state change
- [ ] Claim state narrowed or corrected
- [ ] New evidence added
- [ ] Refutation or supersession recorded

## Required updates

- [ ] Discovery README and `CLAIM.json` agree
- [ ] Revision record added when standing changed
- [ ] Default repository checks pass
- [ ] No private correspondence, credentials, personal paths, or unlicensed third-party material added
- [ ] AI assistance and provenance are disclosed where material
